_readme: Homepage copy (Version 1.7; Full Site Iteration V1, October 2026: the revised About and practice paragraphs, one emphasized phrase in the Select Work introduction and in the practice paragraph, and the Contact headline's second sentence in the accent). Select Work cards are drawn from each case study's frontmatter in src/content/work/.

intro._note: The homepage opening sequence (Intro.astro), since the V1.5 brief of October 16, 2026: the viewing note alone (the Creator Marketing V1.0 brief, October 17, 2026, removed the three phrases), exactly as approved and written in capitals as approved. Once per browsing session, never when returning from a case study; see Intro.astro for the timing.

hero._note: Version 1.4 hero. The name is title case and repeats as a moving stream behind the subject; the separator between repeats is an em dash, which is deliberate typography and the one place an em dash is allowed on the site. The descriptor uses exactly the wording, punctuation and capitalization of the footer line and renders uppercase through CSS.
hero.name: John Cowin

work.heading: Select Work
work.copy: The examples below show how I move from strategy through execution and coordinate the people, systems, and details required to ship.

reel._note: Version 1.8: a purely visual transition after Select Work. The 24 approved pieces in `pool` are shuffled on each fresh visit (kept for the rest of the browser session) and dealt into three rows of `perRow`; a row is repeated only as far as it takes to leave no blank edge. The images are decorative: empty alt text, no captions or labels. Excluded by decision: the 2:53 PM screenshot (financial comparison claims), the 2:59 PM screenshot (live figures that age), Discord.jpeg and Educational.jpeg.
reel._alike: Mobile Optimization V1: on phones the pool is dealt into `phoneRows` rows instead of three (about six to a row, no piece repeated), and the pieces in one `alike` group, which would read as duplicates stacked one above the other, are kept out of neighboring rows and from sitting side by side: the two explainer stills, the two Ambur frames, the two orange Archway fields, the two yellow Bolt fields, and the three white Archway announcements.

practice._note: What I Do and How I Work in one section (Version 1.7), kept in Version 1.8 with the approved How I Work statement, the four capability groups and an 18-tool Stack drawn from the approved brand SVGs in src/assets/stack. Since Version 1.9 the statement carries no visible How I Work label, and each Stack group's heading and tools are centered in its column. Full Site Iteration V1 (October 2026): the statement is John's revised paragraph, `how.em` its one emphasized phrase, and a capability icon answers the pointer with one complete turn (no tilt).
practice.heading: From positioning to production.

how.copy: I move between strategy and execution, building clear systems and working closely with the people responsible for shipping. AI accelerates research, organization, production, and analysis, while judgment, verification, brand fit, and final approval remain mine.

stack.label: Stack
stack._note: Version 1.8: 18 tools, each shown with its approved brand SVG from src/assets/stack in the same neutral tile. `scale` nudges a mark that reads large or small at the shared size; `shape: wide` sets the MDX wordmark across rather than in a square. Microsoft Teams and Grammarly are the first to move off the homepage if the Stack ever needs to thin.

about._note: About (Version 1.7; its first two paragraphs revised in Full Site Iteration V1, and the headline and all three paragraphs replaced with John's approved copy in the About Copy delta, October 2026): the static headline (three short sentences, set one to a line on phones and tablets and as one line across the canvas on desktop), then three paragraphs (the music and business foundation, Phi Labs Global and the wider role, and the concluding positioning line, set a step larger), the resume action on the concluding row, a thin rule and the trust bar, composed so the whole section fits one desktop frame. Double asterisks mark the three highlights, rendered in blue-teal at a slightly heavier weight, never with a highlighter background; nothing else is bold. The complete text is in the HTML; with JavaScript and motion allowed its words flow in once, in reading order, when About comes into view. V1.3 (October 2026): John's approved four paragraphs (the music foundation, Phi Labs Global, Bolt Liquidity and the commercial result, and the concluding line). Three highlights (global music project, more than 200,000 people, more than $300 million in processed volume); the concluding line is set bold as a whole, in the heading color, with no highlight inside it.
about.heading: Creative instincts. Operator discipline. Built for DeFi.

paragraphs.text: For a decade, I built audiences and ran the business side of a **global music project**. That work landed sponsorships, media appearances, and major bookings. In 2021, I brought those skills to DeFi.

Phi Labs Global hired me in 2024 to lead social across a product portfolio with an audience of **more than 200,000 people**. Over time, I took ownership of positioning and messaging, technical documentation and websites, partnerships and KOL management, and campaigns and distribution.

At Bolt Liquidity, I joined before launch and worked across product marketing, partnerships, content, and growth, helping drive ecosystem relationships and integrations as the protocol grew from zero to **more than $300 million in processed volume**.
Today, I turn complex products into stories people understand and connect with.

commercial._note: V1.3, polished in V1.4 (October 2026): the homepage's commercial proof, after the trust bar and before Select Work (CommercialProof.astro), on its own deep teal-charcoal ground. John's approved copy, word for word; **text** is set in bold. One dominant result, the paragraph, then the direct integrations (integrations.json, in its order) with a fourth, typographic tile for the downstream integrations. Never a count for the downstream integrations; no Sui Foundation or Mysten Labs here.
commercial.copy: I joined Bolt before launch and helped turn **early ecosystem conversations into key integrations**. As its distribution expanded, the protocol grew from zero to **more than $300 million in processed volume**.

contact._note: Full Site Iteration V1 (October 2026): `accent`, the headline's second sentence, is set in the section's accent color wherever Contact appears (full and compact); the heading stays one sentence for assistive technology.
contact.heading: Your product is complex. Its story shouldn’t be.
contact.copy: If you need someone who can bring clarity from positioning through execution, let’s talk.
